defaults.unsubscribeText: You are receiving this because you requested a Jimmy Coco Pro trial or asked to continue the professional conversation.

messages.title: A real-client test, at your pace
messages.preview: A simple way to evaluate the professional solution in your own setting.
messages.headline: A useful trial gives you something real to judge.

blocks.html: You have already requested the trial. The useful next step is not another product pitch; it is one considered real-client test in the setting where you would actually use the professional solution.

items: Application: how the solution feels through your usual HVLP workflow.
Finished result: how the finish develops over the stated 6–8-hour window.
Service fit: whether the result suits the treatment you want {{{BUSINESS_NAME}}} to offer.

blocks.html: There is no pressure to decide quickly. If you would like a second pair of eyes on how to structure the test, Matthew will help personally.
Or reply RESULT or TRIAL and Matthew will pick it up personally.

messages.title: What to notice in the first result
messages.preview: Assess application, finish and service fit—without overcomplicating the test.
messages.headline: Separate the product from the whole service experience.

blocks.html: When you review a first professional result, it helps to look at the service in three parts rather than trying to decide everything from one number or one photograph.

items: Application: how it works through your regular equipment.
Finish: how the developed colour reads in daylight, photographs and the client’s mirror.
Menu fit: whether the consultation and result make sense inside your current service.

blocks.html: Those are the questions that make the trial useful. If you would like to talk through the result, Matthew is available to help.
Reply RESULT for a human-led result review.

messages.title: The service maths after a good test
messages.preview: A clear solution-cost baseline before labour, premises and the rest of your service costs.
messages.headline: A clear baseline before you price the service your way.

blocks.html: If the test looks right in your hands, the next sensible question is whether the service economics work for your business.
The current UK professional 1-litre solution is £60 and provides approximately 28 full-body tans. That is an approximate solution cost of £2.14 per tan.
It is a baseline, not a profit promise or a suggested treatment price. Labour, disposables, card fees, premises and VAT still belong in your own calculation.
Reply NUMBERS and Matthew will talk it through using your service model.

messages.title: The next step is yours
messages.preview: One final note with three straightforward ways to continue the conversation.
messages.headline: I will leave the timing with you.

blocks.html: If you would like to continue the conversation for {{{BUSINESS_NAME}}}, there are three simple routes.

items: RESULT: talk through the trial and what you noticed.
NUMBERS: review the service calculation using your own model.
ORDER: discuss the professional ordering route with Matthew.

blocks.html: If the timing is not right, there is nothing you need to do. This follow-up will pause here and Matthew will be available when you are ready.
